technique.title: Write the steps, then paper
technique.audioText: Name the place. Line up the decimal point. For long division, divide, multiply, subtract, bring down. Then do a fresh problem on paper.
technique.body: Fractions, decimals, and percents name the same share (1/2 = 0.5 = 50%). For long multiplication and division: keep places in columns. Divide → multiply → subtract → bring down. The app shows the path once. The real work is on paper.
